This is the AGENTS.md §3b-cond item-5 failure directly ("the class axiomatises hypotheses, not the conclusion; the theorem must DERIVE its conclusion from them"). The class is never inhabited, which for an open conjecture is expected and is NOT itself the defect — carrying the conclusion is. Fix: restate so the class carries the genuine sub-hypotheses and the theorem composes them (exemplar: QOU/FluidDynamics/q_bkm_criterion.lean); if no honest derivation exists, demote to conjecture — a claim change needing owner sign-off. Detected by the type-match pass; the name gate missed it because `SelfConjugate` is outside CONCLUSION_FIELD.
